sections.title: Major Partner of the Tour de France
sections.text: The Tour de France is measured in every climb, every turn, every kilometer and the drive to keep moving forward. In 2027, we will take to the roads as a major partner of the Tour de France and the Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift and the sponsor of the white jersey for both men and women. For us, the race for health is on.

sections.title: The Power of Chasing A Dream
sections.text: Every day, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We apply our deep understanding of the immune system to develop breakthrough innovations in medicines and vaccines so you can focus on what matters most, chasing your dreams. If you’re chasing your dreams, remember... you’re not alone. We’re right beside you
